messages:
mia: Hey folks! Quick poll — who’s into the Cozy Window Photo challenge? Bring your best mug, lights, or tiny santas. :coffee::sparkles:
omar: I'm in! Will bribe with homemade chai. Anyone want a swap of recipes? :yum:
jen: I can do pics Saturday morning. Also have a mini holiday cactus that bloomed 🌵🎉
ops-bot: Reminder: Free hot chocolate in kitchen from 3–4pm today. :hot_chocolate:
samira: Count me in. Also quick Q: does anyone actually own a window Santa? I mean the cardboard/window cling ones?
zane: 😂 I have a giant inflatable santa for my porch. Taking it inside would be a saga.
mia: Ha! No pressure to bring inflatable, window clings or just a cozy corner. Just snap a pic and post. We'll do a silly bracket on Monday to vote best glow.
jen: Ooh bracket idea — can we add 'most likely to warm a keyboard' category?
omar: yes. Also recipe for chai:
```
1 cup milk
1 tsp loose black tea
1/2 tsp crushed cardamom
1 small cinnamon stick
1/2 tsp grated ginger
simmer ~8 mins, sweeten to taste
```
samira: Love the recipe. Can someone bring mugs? My cabinet is tiny.
mia: I can bring 6 mismatched mugs :heart: 
zane: I can bring a box of those single-use chocolate stir sticks.
jen: I'll bring cookies 🍪 (gluten-free option available)
ops-bot: @people-ops FYI: this is non-official but looks like ~10 people might swing by. No hazard expected.
samira: Also, tiny fun: window Santa spotting — if you see a Santa in someone's window, take a pic and drop it here. Winner gets a virtual sticker and bragging rights.
omar: Challenge accepted. My porch Santa is on standby.
mia: I'll post a pic around 8am Sat. Quick poll: do we want #random pinned for submissions or a dedicated thread?
jen: Keep here — easier.
zane: +1 keep here
samira: +1
mia: Cool. See you all at hot chocolate hour. :sparkles:
jen: can't wait :)
omar: same! :steam_locomotive: (that's supposed to be a train but it's the cozy steam vibe)
